neighbours.label: ' like' in an explicit comparison ('X is like Y')
fire: Teachers can show students how a cell is like a small factory.
The economy is like a ship that turns slowly.
In many ways memory is like a muscle that grows with use.
She explained that the atom is like a tiny solar system.
For him, writing a novel was like running a marathon.
The new manager says a team is like a family.
His voice on the radio was like warm honey.
The coach told us that defence is like a chess game.
quiet: Teachers can show students how a cell makes proteins and energy.
The economy is turning slowly after the long recession.
In many ways memory grows stronger with regular use.
She explained that the atom has a nucleus and electrons.
For him, writing a novel took more than four years.
The new manager says the team works very hard.
His voice on the radio was warm and calm.
The coach told us that defence wins most games.

notes: Card flags broad (6.8% at 0.1 of max), peaks are mixed (like, colons, Arabic suffixes); this tests only the top example.
